name: gateway-mcp
description: Single GatewayMCP boundary for private MCP servers, company context, and corporate memory.

GATEWAY_MCP_URL.description: Remote GatewayMCP HTTP endpoint. Production: https://gateway.example.com/mcp

GATEWAY_MCP_TOKEN.description: Fallback Gateway bearer token for agents without MCP OAuth support.

interface.shortDescription: Connect agents to the GatewayMCP boundary.
interface.longDescription: Provides a remote MCP entry point for routed private MCP access, company context, and corporate memory. Claude Code authenticates through GatewayMCP OAuth; non-OAuth agents can use GATEWAY_MCP_URL and GATEWAY_MCP_TOKEN as a fallback.
defaultPrompt: Use GatewayMCP for company context, tools, memory, access policy, and audited project work.
